# Filosign

> Wallet-native document signing: end-to-end encrypted files, verifiable signing records on Base, optional USDC payout packets, and gated file release when signing conditions are met. Public beta.

Extended product summary: https://filosign.xyz/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://filosign.xyz/sitemap-index.xml

## Product (try the app)

- https://sandbox.filosign.xyz — Try Filosign (testnet demo, no account required to explore)
- https://app.filosign.xyz — Web application (wallet sign-in, send/sign envelopes)
- https://filosign.xyz/pricing/ — Plans: Free, Solo, Teams, Teams Pro, Enterprise
